justification: Account deletion flow with 30-day grace period and reactivation option via support; honest and fair.
Flash sale with concrete 'ends in 4 hours' deadline and honest 50% off; standard time-limited promo, no countdown reset or false scarcity evidence.
Reel feed with explicit 'Load more reels' button and 'End of results' marker; continuation requires affirmative user action.
Offer dialog whose close (X) button works and directly dismisses; copy explicitly notes it never moves. Honest.
Signup with visible Terms/Privacy checkbox; partner-policy clause is disclosed in the label itself; button disabled until consent.
Multiple dark patterns: fake scarcity ('Only 2 left — sale ends tonight'), pre-checked +$39.99 protection plan, and buried auto-renewing $9.99/mo membership in 7px fine print.
Flight booking shows 'all-inclusive total' with all fees (booking, convenience, taxes) itemized upfront; total constant across all states through payment.
Gym membership cancellation is the primary prominent action; 'cancel anytime' disclosed; no retention tricks.
Consent banner biased toward surrender: large 'Accept All' vs tiny low-contrast 'Manage options'; no reject button on first screen.
10-second wait before free PDF access with $1.99 removal offer; fully disclosed upfront and document readable during the wait.
Contact-harvesting pressure: huge 'Invite all 128 contacts' CTA vs 8px dotted low-contrast 'skip'; opt-out deliberately degraded.
Plain pricing card with honest feature list and visible fine print about storage add-ons; no tricks.
Settings page labeled 'No exit': offers data download and marketing preferences but no account deletion or opt-out of retention (10 yrs); roach-motel pattern.
Fake engagement notifications ('Someone liked your post', 'A user is viewing your profile') with no identity reference, designed to bait clicks; 'views growing every minute'.
Data-processing notice in plain English (FKGL 10.5), user can object/access/correct/delete; honest consent.
Free trial auto-converts to paid $14.99/mo charge via cached payment token; no cancel option, no reminder, no disclosure of auto-renewal in visible copy.
Seasonal sale with concrete, verifiable deadline (Friday 23:59 CET, 2 days 6 hours) and concrete answer to 'when does it end'; genuine time constraint.
Newsletter popup with large 44x44 close button; dismissed cleanly in one click.
Privacy control ('Data & cookies') buried under up to 6 levels of nested expanding menus; opt-out made artificially hard to reach.
Fake countdown: 'ends in 0:10' deadline keeps being shifted forward by the backend each time it hits zero; urgency is fabricated.
News feed where the ad card is clearly labeled 'AD' and 'Sponsored'; genuine editorial content kept separate.
Checkout interrupted by injected upsell modal ('Wait! Don't leave without this!') for a $2.99/mo subscription; payment disabled until user responds; subscription framed as one-click add.
Game with fair linear progression curve (level n needs n forges, +10 gold each); no escalating grind or paywall pressure.
Forced account creation at checkout: 'Create account & checkout' dominates while 'Continue as guest' is tiny low-contrast text users miss.
Consent banner language mismatch: headline English but the only opt-out button rendered in French for an en-US user; accept-all is the only button in user's language.
Feed refresh with honest spinner/progress tracking actual network timing; no fake loading or manipulation.
Cart extras clearly labeled 'Optional extras — your choice' with explicit opt-in buttons; transparent totals after each addition.
Video watchlist with 'Autoplay next: OFF — playback stops and waits for you'; playback only starts on explicit user click.
Free trial with $5/mo auto-renewal disclosed via button tooltip and Subscription details; disclosure exists but is somewhat buried.
Fake scarcity: pulsing 'Only 2 left at this price!' badge; stock never depletes and is stuck at a fabricated low threshold.
Cookie modal with only an 'Accept all' button and no reject/manage option; consent is forced by design.
Endless pagination hiding content ('1/3 • hidden', 'there is always one more page') with a running time counter; designed to keep the user reading.
Contact invite flow with explicit per-contact checkboxes, nothing pre-selected, and 'Nothing is sent until you confirm'.
Forced consent: pre-checked disabled checkbox labeled 'consent assumed', consent auto-registers after a 2s timer even if user does nothing, customization 'coming soon'.
Single optional marketing consent, visible, unchecked, close to the button; honest opt-in design.
Purchase confirmation explicitly warns 'This cannot be undone... charged $29.99 now and every month thereafter until you cancel'; honest auto-renewal disclosure.
Pay-what-you-want slider with transparent 'everyday price' label; no anchoring tricks or hidden fees.

Forced Grace Period: deletion confirm states a 30-day mandatory delay (>=24h tau) with 'reactivate' reversal hook within the same node (semantic proximity of reversal); offboarding is time-gated and entangled with retention.

Limited Time Message checks fail: hue probe shows 210deg not in [0,45] urgency spectrum, so no compound visual-linguistic urgency signal; 'ends in 4 hours' is a concrete duration with no countdown node, no reset, no perpetual-extension evidence across states.

Infinite Scrolling/Addictive Design checks fail: content appends only on explicit 'Load more reels' affirmative action (no autonomous E_fetch), and an 'End of results' stopping cue is rendered in every state.
Small or Moving Close Button (Microscopic Hitbox): close button is h-6 w-6 = 24x24px, below WCAG 44x44 touch-target minimum (tau_wcag_hitbox); no interception/moving but the hitbox condition fires.

Automatic Accept Third Party Term: single checkbox bundles primary ToS/Privacy WITH partner policies (transitive consent) with no individual toggles for the third-party agreements; 'policies of our partners' is an opaque entity umbrella (E_declared ~ 0).

Multiple checks fire: Bad Defaults/Preselection (protection plan checkbox pre-initialized checked at t0, financial cost domain); Sneak Into Basket (unprompted +$39.99 item in order); Hidden Information (auto-renewing $9.99/mo membership in 7px/40%-contrast fine print, adverse term 'auto-renew' concealed typographically); FOMO lexemes ('Only 2 left', 'sale ends tonight').

Drip Pricing checks fail: P(s0)=P(s3)=$165.89 across all states (no sequential inflation) and fee keywords (booking/convenience/taxes) are present in the initial state, so no semantic concealment of mandatory fees.
Immortal Accounts checks fail: deletion ('Cancel my membership') is the primary prominent button (no asymmetry, no absence of exit vector); 'cancel anytime' disclosed.

Privacy Maze: d(start,reject_all)>=2 > d(start,accept_all)=1 with huge visual prominence disparity between 'Accept All' and 9px 'Manage options' (P(accept)/P(manage) >> delta); Customisation nesting: reject buried in manage flow; consent graph biased to surrender.

Pay To Avoid check fails: the 10s wait is disclosed upfront, the document is fully readable during the wait (U_default not suppressed), delay bar occupies small viewport fraction; no friction amplification across states.

Address Book Leeching: invite-all button dominates skip (huge py-4 bold shadow button vs 8px dotted underline skip) exceeding invite-dominance ratio; benefactive framing 'make SnapGrid better for everyone'; Friend Spam: mass dispatch of all 128 contacts with no granular selection (S_selected=0, dispatch ~ C_network).
No ontology pattern fires: honest $12/mo pricing, visible fine print clarifying storage; no defaults, no urgency, no hidden terms.

Immortal Accounts (Absolute Absence of Deletion Vectors): K_del ('delete/deactivate/close account/remove profile') intersects empty with all settings text; only download data/marketing ON/retention 10 yrs — no structural exit affordance, badge literally says 'No exit'.

Activity Messages: notifications 'Someone liked your post', 'A user is viewing your profile' lack any identity reference (Specificity < tau, no IdentityRef) = fabricated aggregated social signals; High Demand metric fabrication ('214 profile views growing every minute').
Complex Language/Privacy Maze semantic checks fail: FKGL 10.5 below grade-9 public threshold, plain-English notice, object/access/correct/delete rights stated; consent checkbox honest.

Forced Continuity: at t>=expiry the account silently transitions trial->premium and charges the cached token (Visa 4242, $14.99/mo) with no explicit consent at conversion and no renewal warning rendered in any state (absence of temporal feedforward).

Limited Time Message check fails: concrete deadline 'Friday 23:59 CET' is present in the DOM (T_end in DOM, Specificity high), no deadline shifting across states; concrete answer to 'when does it end' — genuine time constraint.
Small or Moving Close Button checks fail: close hitbox is 44x44px (meets WCAG touch-target), aria-label 'Close dialog' descriptive, handler closes directly; dismissed in one click.

Labyrinthine Navigation/Customisation: 'Data & cookies' buried at nesting depth up to 6 levels with growing indentation (0->12px->...), exceeding depth/nesting thresholds; privacy controls visually obfuscated under hierarchical nesting.

Limited Time Message (Perpetual Extension)/FOMO (Artificial Temporal Scarcity): state text confirms end(i+1)=current+delay each time the countdown hits zero — 'the deadline never arrived', constraint is infinite; countdown timer is stateless and reset per session.

Disguised Ad checks fail: the ad card is explicitly labeled 'AD' and 'Sponsored' with clear container separation — no cross-origin action masking, no morphological/semantic masquerade of native actions.

Pressured Selling (Transactional Flow Interruption): clicking Proceed injects upsell modal and payment stays disabled until a decision ('s_final not in current'); high-arousal copy 'Wait! Don't leave without this!' and a $2.99/mo subscription disguised as a one-click shipping add ('1-Click').
Grinding checks fail: effort scales linearly (level n needs n forges) with constant +10 gold reward — no exponential effort scaling, no diminishing visual feedback; 'Fair curve' confirmed by states.

Forced Registration (Visual Degradation of Guest Pathway): guest checkout is an 8px text link vs large filled 'Create account & checkout' button — visual weight ratio far below guest-visibility threshold; user state s1 confirms most users never notice the guest link.

Wrong Language: browser locale en-US but the only opt-out control rendered in French ('Refuser les cookies non essentiels') while headline and accept button are English — L_DOM(critical node) != L_browser; language switched exactly at the consent/termination control.
Pull-To-Refresh checks fail: spinner duration 402ms tracks real network time (no artificial suspense >=1s), no variable-ratio reward evidence; honest refresh.
Bad Defaults/Sneak Into Basket checks fail: extras are explicit opt-in buttons ('Optional extras — your choice'), cart total only grows when user adds; free returns disclosed.
Auto-Play checks fail: 'Autoplay next: OFF' with explicit disclosure, playback starts only on user click (E_intent present); no autonomous media execution across states.

Hidden Information (Semantic Concealment of Adverse Terms): auto-renewal and $5.00 fee appear only in a collapsed <details> element and a hover tooltip (title attribute) — adverse-term keywords present in DOM but in concealed render states; no visible renewal warning.

Low Stock (Inventory Fabrication): state text confirms stock 'stuck at a fabricated low threshold' and never depletes (I_displayed << I_true); pulsing animated urgency badge (FOMO pulsation / High Demand animated social-proof, animate-pulse) drives panic purchase.
Dead End: overlay (z-index 1000) has zero dismissal vectors (no close icon, no reject/manage) and its only outgoing edge is 'Accept all' — every path forces compliance; no escape path.

Addictive Design (Eradication of Natural Stopping Cues / infinite continuation): '1/3 • hidden' shows content gated behind pagination with 'there is always one more page' and a session timer 'You have been reading for 00:0X' — no reachable terminal state; hidden content cues push endless reading.

Friend Spam checks fail: granular per-contact selection present, nothing pre-selected, dispatch only after explicit confirm ('Invite selected (0)', 'Nothing is sent until you confirm') — S_selected >= 0 required, no unauthorized broadcast.

Bad Defaults (pre-checked disabled checkbox 'consent assumed', privacy-loss domain) + Automating The User Away: consent auto-registers after a 2-tick 1.0s window below the ~2.0s reaction baseline with no user action; Customize 'coming soon' removes any granular path.
Bad Defaults/Privacy Zuckering checks fail: the single marketing consent is unchecked at t0, visible, near the submit button; no pre-selected provider-favorable state.

Reduced Friction checks fail: explicit confirmation language present ('This cannot be undone. You will be charged $29.99 now and every month thereafter until you cancel') — confirmation node on the commit path.
No pattern fires: fiat price $149 with honest 'everyday price' label, pay-what-you-want slider without inflated anchors (no reference-point obfuscation), no unit-price suppression or hidden fees.
